sourceFamily.businessMeaning: Certificate variants consolidate into one governed request with object reference and a data-minimized issuance event.

IAQ-010 operations certificate/document metadata projection at the accepted browser and owner paths
PEP-HRM-012 requestCertificate POST command with the accepted headers, request body and 202 CommandReceiptV1 response
People-owned durable certificate request and issued-certificate metadata state
CertificateIssued.v1 with only the accepted minimized payload
An internal render, seal and object adapter interface, a fail-closed production binding and a test-only conformance double

self.condition: personPublicId equals the trusted actor person public ID

operations.condition: personPublicId does not equal the trusted actor person public ID

teamManagementDisposition.rule: Stage A has no accepted team certificate requester or issuer profile; TEAM_MANAGEMENT is denied before mutation and may be reconsidered only by a separate accepted successor.

authorizationBranch.denialRule: A denied TEAM_MANAGEMENT or non-self branch never falls back to self or operations, and a caller-supplied role, duty, mode, population or tenant is ignored and denied.

commonActionRisk.reason: The accepted transport has one method and path and no trusted discriminator that allows Gateway to apply a weaker self-service route before owner authorization.

entryQueryContract.projectionRule: Both projections are metadata-only and expose no document content, download URL, verification token, revoke control or unapproved field group.

eventContract.transaction: Request state ISSUED, immutable issued metadata, succeeded receipt, audit pointer and semantic outbox append commit atomically.

lifecycleDisposition.splitAggregateRule: The request row remains ISSUED after issuance; REVOKED and EXPIRED belong only to ppl_issued_certificates and are never written into ppl_certificate_requests.
lifecycleDisposition.immutability: Subject snapshot, business purpose, locale, template and seal version, object reference, object version, content digest and verification-token hash cannot be overwritten; delete is denied.

observedConflict.protocol: state-guard section 4 scopes a key by tenant_id, command_type and Idempotency-Key
observedConflict.existingV54Constraint: uk_ppl_command_receipts_key scopes uniqueness by tenant_id, subject_principal_public_id, originating_action and idempotency_key

idempotencyDisposition.preservation: The V54 table, existing unique constraint and immutable originating-context trigger remain; subject and originating action remain sealed context rather than replay-scope discriminators.
behavior: same key and same canonical request hash returns the original receipt
same key and different canonical request hash returns 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED
concurrent reservation serializes before domain mutation
terminal success or rejection never reruns its side effect

allowed: CertificateArtifactPort interface inside the HRM-009 owner package
FailClosedCertificateArtifactAdapter production binding that performs no network, filesystem, object or signature side effect and returns an unavailable classification
CertificateArtifactConformanceDouble under the exact test package for deterministic request-to-issued conformance tests
forbidden: invented provider endpoint or provider capability
local seal, signature, verification or download service
production success fallback to the conformance double
artifactAdapterDisposition.productionRule: Until a separately accepted shared render, seal and object binding exists, the feature remains OFF and the production adapter fails closed without creating an issued row or CertificateIssued.v1.

noDoubleCreate: No tenant may have both the generic Platform employment-certificate creator and the HRM certificate creator writable at the same time.
Before any later HRM enrollment, central control retires or hides the Platform seed for that tenant and records proof that new generic creation is impossible.
Existing and open Platform svc_requests remain Platform-owned and complete there; they are not copied, migrated, linked or mirrored into People.
Historical Platform deep links continue to resolve under /hr/services.
Rollback disables HRM creation before central control may reactivate the generic Platform seed.
activationOrder: product-authorization v52 and Auth V261 centrally admitted
shared production artifact adapter separately accepted
Platform generic creator retired or hidden for the selected tenant
HRM feature enrollment may be considered by a later activation authority

nonClaims: This disposition does not complete BASE-TFR-HRM-009 or HRM-GOLD-012.
This disposition does not define or authorize download, revoke or verification transport.

This disposition excludes access/download audit implementation from Stage A but preserves both expiry acceptance and separately authorized access/download audit acceptance as mandatory full-slice boundaries.
This disposition does not assert that a production render, seal, signature or object provider is available.
This disposition does not modify the generic Platform service center or authorize tenant cutover.
This disposition does not authorize product-authorization v52, Auth V261, Gateway or shell writes in a module worktree.
This disposition grants zero business-completion credit before central admission and a later activation decision.
